name: Michael Nicholas Kulp
notable_stories: Michael Nicholas Kulp and three of his brothers were in the Civil War from 1861-1863, PA Bucktail Regiment of sharpshooters
Sarah Kulp went to Illinois to be near her parents the Vancels while John was in the war
John Jacob Kulp was their first child
milestones: Buried at Orting, WA Soldiers Home Cemetery

Buried: Michael Nicholas Kulp is buried at the Washington Soldiers Home Cemetery in Orting.
Military: Michael Kulp served in the Civil War from 1861 to 1863 in the Pennsylvania Bucktail Regiment of sharpshooters, as did three of his brothers.
locations: Washington Soldiers Home Cemetery, Orting, Washington
sources: Family research emails, 2011–2013 (John and Barbara Adams with Irma Kulp Zacher, George F. Adams, Bill Allen and others)
